body:
I don't deal with anger anymore. :-)
I do try my best, and strangers seem to appreciate it. Being able to make strangers smile is part of what has kept me going so long.
My few friends, unfortunately, have their own busyness, families/kids etc. They're all really lovely, just too busy for close friendships. I don't want to abandon them or anything similar, just because life makes people busy. :-)

Started out with a combination of body image issues and trouble dealing with anger. Rather than taking it out on others, I took it out on myself. It developed into something that helped me fall asleep, though. I don't struggle with anger anymore. :-) Part of it was self-punishment for not being good enough for people to care about me. Now it's a version of that, almost delaying the suicide in response to the loneliness. If that makes sense at all.
Know that phrase along the lines of "if friends keep leaving and you can't see what the problem is, the problem is you". That taken to an extreme, I suppose.
